scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.clean:legacy: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const paths = ['components', 'services', 'types.ts', 'App.tsx', 'index.tsx', 'index.html', 'vite.config.ts', 'server/models', 'server/routes']; paths.forEach(p => { if(fs.existsSync(p)) { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Removed legacy: ' + p); }}); console.log('Cleanup complete.
